title: Postgres live (this server)
description: Queried straight from pg_stat_activity on this server's database, so it always shows this server even on the hub.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pid, application_name AS holder, usename AS "user", datname AS db, host(client_addr) AS client, state,
       wait_event_type || ':' || wait_event AS waiting_on, array_to_string(pg_blocking_pids(pid), ',') AS blocked_by,
       extract(epoch FROM now() - xact_start)::int AS in_transaction, extract(epoch FROM now() - query_start)::int AS query_age,
       extract(epoch FROM now() - backend_start)::int AS connected, left(query, 500) AS query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
ORDER BY xact_start NULLS LAST, backend_start

panels.title: Blocking chain: who waits on whom

targets.rawSql:
SELECT w.pid AS waiting_pid, w.application_name AS waiting_holder, extract(epoch FROM now() - w.query_start)::int AS waiting_for,
       left(w.query, 300) AS waiting_query,
       b.pid AS blocking_pid, b.application_name AS blocking_holder, b.state AS blocking_state,
       extract(epoch FROM now() - b.xact_start)::int AS blocking_transaction_age, left(b.query, 300) AS blocking_query
FROM pg_stat_activity w
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(pg_blocking_pids(w.pid)) AS bp(pid)
JOIN pg_stat_activity b ON b.pid = bp.pid
ORDER BY waiting_for DESC

SELECT coalesce(nullif(application_name, ''), 'unnamed') AS holder, state, count(*) AS connections
FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Top statements since the last stats reset

targets.rawSql:
SELECT left(s.query, 500) AS query, d.datname AS db, s.calls, round(s.total_exec_time::numeric / 1000, 1) AS total_s,
       round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 1) AS mean_ms, s.rows
FROM pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid = s.dbid
ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 25
